comment: Scene lengths in beats (120 BPM: 1 beat = 15 frames = 0.5 s), 48 beats = 24 s. Ép. 2 of « La chèvre a encore frappé ». Every cut is hard: the courtyard is one continuous set and the goat chews on the video's clock. Each proof holds still long enough to read: the 17/20 in her mouth (the cover), the test in the replay before the bite, the lock screen, the grade in the inbox, the score. The music loops; the picture cuts from her stare under the end card back to her stare on the cover. scripts/chevre-02/make-music.mjs reads this file.
